preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the graph is at least 3 and at most 10^5.
The number of edges in the graph is at least 2 and at most 10^5.
Each node in the graph is connected by edges with at least k other nodes.
The nodes connected by each edge are distinct integers between 1 and n.
The graph does not contain self-loops or multiple edges.

postconditions.description: The length of the found cycle is at least k + 1.
Each node in the cycle is a valid node index.
The nodes in the cycle are distinct.
The cycle starts and ends at the same node.

postconditions.expression: all(v_i and v_{i+1} are connected by an edge for 1 <= i < r)
postconditions.description: Each consecutive pair of nodes in the cycle are connected by an edge.
